weather: hard frost, snow on the wind
notes: Fresh campaign, combat-forward world. Run session 0 first: create characters (docs/character-schema.md), add their ids to party[], then open on the Long Wall at dusk with Captain Brunna assigning the party a bastion — the night probe comes before the first watch ends. Pacing: a real fight most sessions, built with the encounter-building skill; between fights, the siege itself is the clock (stores, morale, the sealed Deep Door). Enemy morale matters — raiders who lose half their number withdraw.
